audience: managers and HR staff who run rotas, leave and timesheets in Shiftbrook

useCases.title: Check the rota for a site and a date range
useCases.text: List the locations, then list the shifts between two dates to see the rota. Open one shift for its details. Draft shifts are not published.

useCases.title: Review leave requests waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the pending leave requests, then open one to read its dates and details.

useCases.title: Approve a leave request after review
useCases.text: Open the leave request, then approve it. Approval also changes the approved absence, so check the request first.

useCases.title: Find who is absent during a bank holiday week
useCases.text: List the approved absences that overlap a date range, such as the bank holiday week. Look up a person for their details.

useCases.title: Compare approved hours across the team
useCases.text: List the approved timesheets for a period, which include the approved hours. Open one timesheet for its details.

useCases.title: Add a new person to the organisation
useCases.text: Add a person to the organisation. Shiftbrook sends that person an invite email, so check the details first.
